archetypes.name: wire-contract
archetypes.rationale: This migration has dozens of exact stdout contracts — KV key order, NDJSON field sets, conditional KV emission phases (especially promote-latest), quiet-routing reinit, exit-code mapping — that are easy to silently regress during Bash-to-Python porting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the Python ports against the wire contracts preserved in the plan. Focus on: (1) stdout KV key emission order for audit-runs resolve-prs (six-key order), promote-latest conditional phase KVs, and close-priors TAB-separated CLOSE_FAILED rows; (2) NDJSON field sets for scan-run rows — cursor-ci-stall-causes pass vs informational semantics, ns-retry-sidecars reasons histogram and skip vs fail paths, category-stats partial_data arithmetic, cross-cutting self_deploying_gap as a backward-compatible duplicate; (3) quiet-routing reinit before plugin read-version KV emission; (4) promote-latest pre-selection failures producing no stdout prelude versus post-selection failures preserving already-emitted KVs; (5) audit pacific-timestamp emitting no PACIFIC_TIMESTAMP= line on parse failure. For each contract, identify whether the Python implementation can silently produce wrong key order, extra keys, or missing keys relative to the original bash. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cutover-completeness
archetypes.rationale: Hard cutover with no shims — a single stale invocation of a retired path will break lint-retired-scripts; missing callsite migrations in shipped SKILL.md files break operator workflows immediately on deploy.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that all callsite migrations are complete and no stale references to retired paths survive in shipped surfaces. Check: (1) every bash invocation in .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md and skills/*/SKILL.md for retired script paths (audit-scan-run.sh, audit-preflight.sh, audit-resolve-prs.sh, audit-map-runs.sh, read-plugin-version.sh, verify-main.sh, promote-release.sh, and all others listed in the retired-paths section); (2) Makefile harness targets no longer reference deleted .sh harnesses and correctly delegate to pytest; (3) python/migrated-scripts.tsv includes every deleted path (cross-check the plan's retired-paths list against actual TSV appends); (4) agent-lint.toml and .claude/rules/gh-body-file.md allowlists no longer reference retired script paths; (5) scripts/test-implement-finalize.sh, skills/implement/scripts/test-refresh-execution-issues.sh, and skills/implement/scripts/test-post-tracking-issue.sh stubs are updated to use the Python CLI instead of the old .sh stubs. Flag any retired path that still appears in a non-test, non-comment surface that would survive make lint-retired-scripts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
